title: Width Expansion as a Method for Class Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Class Incremental Learning (Class-IL) requires models to learn new classes over time while preserving previously acquired knowledge without access to past data or task identity. This setting intensifies the stability-plasticity dilemma and makes catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Existing approaches include regularization, knowledge distillation, replay, and architectural expansion. However, many expansion methods rely on explicit task identifiers or predefined growth strategies, limiting their applicability when task boundaries are unavailable at inference time. This work proposes a dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons within existing layers according to a normalized loss criterion, without requiring task-specific information. An attention mechanism with persistent key-value memory is also incorporated to stabilize feature representations and reduce interference between previously learned and n

translated_title: 宽度扩展作为类增量学习的一种方法
translated_abstract: 类增量学习要求模型在学习新类别的同时保留先前获得的知识，且无法访问过去的数据或任务身份。这种设置加剧了稳定性与可塑性之间的困境，使灾难性遗忘成为核心挑战。现有方法包括正则化、知识蒸馏、回放和架构扩展。然而，许多扩展方法依赖于显式的任务标识符或预定义的增长策略，这在推理时任务边界不可用的情况下限制了其适用性。本工作提出了一种动态宽度扩展方法，根据归一化损失准则增加现有层中的神经元数量，而无需任务特定信息。此外，还引入了具有持久键值记忆的注意力机制，以稳定特征表示并减少先前学习的内容与新类别之间的干扰。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需任务特定信息的动态宽度扩展方法，通过归一化损失准则增加现有层中的神经元数量，并结合具有持久键值记忆的注意力机制来稳定特征表示，从而在无需任务边界的情况下缓解类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a task-agnostic dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons in existing layers based on a normalized loss criterion, combined with an attention mechanism featuring persistent key-value memory, to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning without requiring task boundaries.
